findings.summary: Declared inward loader-query and output-query edges are absent from Cargo.toml and the arch-check allowlist, so bp-000e passes without proving the extension it describes.

C18 common row fields native_id, harness, adapter and availability are declared only for sources and sessions; turns, messages, tools and events have none, so per-row availability has no wire location for four of six datasets.

The metamorphic digest proof tk-0001 names as part of the baseline check is only partly present, and SourceSelection::admits, from_untrusted, ResultUniverse::validate and Coverage::validate have no tests.
crates/testkit/fixtures/query/shared-v1.json has no consumer and encodes shapes the frozen types cannot deserialize, including a timestamp object against a frozen RFC3339 string form.

Timestamp basis is absent from the wire and hardcoded to Native on both deserialization paths while Json and Jsonl are declared lossy:false, and the closed TimestampBasis has no supplied-or-unknown variant.
Dataset-agnostic validators return ConsultSchema for a hardcoded unrelated dataset, so a sessions time error points at the events schema.
grouping_fields are declared for sources, messages and events, which permit no Stats operation and declare no metrics.

seal.recommendation: Do not seal at 819fc30a. Resolve F1 and F2, land the F3 assertions, and record an explicit decision on F4 and F5, then re-review the delta at its new commit.
